content: Ana Babse-mimmi-egichisad
Efraín-yalaganba, Ramataimʼgi Suf-dule-wargwen maigusad. A-dule, Elcanaʼye nugad, Jeroham-e-machid. Jerohamʼdi, Eliú-e-machid. Eliúʼdi, Tohu-e-machid. Tohuʼdi, Zuf-e-machid. Zufʼdi, Efrateo-duled.
Elcana ome-warbo nikad: Wargwendi, Anaʼye nugad, baiddi, Peninaʼye nugad. Peninaʼdi mimmigan nikad, ar Anaʼdi mimmigan sated.

Birga-irba, Elcana, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad-e-nug-odummogega, e-neggwebur-akar Silo-neggweburse ardaed. Agine, Bab-Jehováʼga ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged ukdaed. Deunni, Elí-e-machimala-warbogwad, Ofniʼye-nugad, degi, Fineesʼye-nugad, Siloʼgi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga mamaid.
Ar ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged-ibagan-mosale, Elcana, e-ome-Peninaʼga, degi, bela e-mimmiganga igar-soglesmaidba Bab-Jehováʼga-ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged-e-goamar ukdaed.
Bab-Dummad Ana-mer-mimmi-nikuega-imaksa-inigwele, Elcana amba Ana-nue-sabdaed. A-ulale, ega ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged-e-goa-bur-nued ukdaed
Ar Bab-Jehová Ana-mer-mimmi-nikuega-imaksadbali, e-isdarad-Penina, Ana-ourwega yamo egi dodoardaed.
Ar birga-irba, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nadmalale, Penina degibi Ana-imakardaed. Penina Anaʼgi dodoardasoggu, Anaʼdi boardasunnad, bar mas-gunbidasulid.
Geb degine, e-sui-Elcana ega sokardaed: “Ana, ¿ibiga be boardae? ¿Ibiga be mas-gunbisurdae? ¿Ibiga be nue-wile-itodae? ¿Ar ande, machimala-warambe-nikulegedba (10), bur bega nuedsursi?”

Ibagwengi, Ana, Silo-neggweburgi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi mas-guchad-sorbali, Bab-Dummadse-golega gwisguded. Agine, Anaʼdi bela-bela ulubgi-nunmak-itogedba, Bab-Jehováʼse isedar-boar gorsii gusad. Deunni, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled Elíʼye-nugad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-e-yawagak-dikarba siid.

Geb degine, Ana Bab-Jehováʼga ise-sogar sogded: “Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadye, Andi be-mai-wilegedid. Be an-dake, an nue wile-itodiid, mer be an-iege. Bab-Jehováʼye, be anga machi-wargwen-ukele, na degisadegu bega-arbaega an imakoed. E-sailagia, bipisaale ei siklegosulid.”
Ar Ana, Bab-Jehováʼse suitii gorsigusad. Degisoggu, Elí, Ana-e-gaya nuu daksii gusad.
Ar ade, Ana binnasuli Bab-Dummadse-gorsisulid. Unnila e-gaya arbo-arbo imaksiid. Degidbali, Elí, Anaʼgi binsaded, mummu-an-dakye.
Geb Elí, Anaʼga sogded: —¿Ar sana be dadakguoe? ¡Vino-gobed ies be imake!
Ana abin-sogded: —Dummad, degisuli. Vino an gobsasulid, inna-gagbid an gobsasurbalid. Unnila gwage-naibi an itoged. A-ulale, an Bab-Jehová-asabin, ulubgi-naibi-itogedgi an gorsiid.
Mer ome-isganayob be an-dake. An-wile-itoged-ular, undar-suitisaar Bab-Jehováʼse an gorsii gusad.
Elí abin-sogded: —Mer bar be bukib-binsao, nuedgi be nae. Israel-e-Bab-Dummadse be ibmar-egichisadi, na e bega ukena gadin.
Ana abin-sogded: —Doggus-nuedi. Bitigi be nued angi-binsadigusana gadin. Weyob Ana sogsagu, nadegusad. Geb agi na mas-gundapid. Agine, Ana bar wile-itossulid.

A-bangine, Elcana na e-omeganmala wakudaryalaba gwisgusad. Geb Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummosad-sorbali, na gannar e-negse Ramá-neggweburse nonimalad. Geb a-sorbali, Elcana, Anaʼse gochad. Agine, Bab-Jehová, Anaʼgi nued-binsasad.
Ana Bab-Jehováʼga Samuel-uksad
Geb Ana gurgin-nika gunonikid. Na ugakgued-e-iba nagunonigua, ega machigwa uklenonikid. “Ar Ana Bab-Jehováʼse egichadbali, Samuelʼye onugsasad.”
Ar Elcana, e-ome-Penina, degi, e-mimmiganmala aligusmalad, Bab-Jehováʼga ise-sogar-sogsadba ibmar-ukega, degine, ibdurgan-ogumakar-birga-irba-ukleged ukbaligar.

Anaʼdi wemarba aligussulid, ar e-sui-Elcanaʼga sogsad: —Machi-bipi mam-iarguedse, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse, Bab-Jehováʼga-oyogega an nidoed. Geb agine, machi-bipi Bab-Dummadga-arbaega degisadegu gudii guoed.

E-sui-Elcana abin-sogded: —Degirdi nabirdo. Be-sogedba be imakdo. Machi-bipi-mam-iarguedse be nasunnodo. Bab-Jehová bega-ibmar-imakoye-sogsad bega imaksun. Degisoggu, Ana e-neggi besad. Geb mam-iargusadse e-machi-bipi-odummosad.

Ana, Samuel-mam-oiar-imaksagua, Elcanaʼbo Silo-neggweburse Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse Samuel-sesmalad. Ana, moli-bebe-nikad-machered-birgapaa-nikad sesad. Deginbali, madubur nibir-dulagwen-gakabo (22) sesbalid, buglugi vino-sesbalid. Deunni, Samuel amba bipigwad.
Modapmargua, moli-bebe-nikad-selealid oburgwismalad. A-sorbali, Ana, Elíʼga machi-bipi sesmalad ega-oyogegar.
Geb Ana, Elíʼga sogded: “Dummad, inniki an bega soged, ar ani an be-walik Bab-Jehováʼse gorsigusadid.
We-machi-bipi Bab-Jehováʼse-an-egichisgusadi, emide, anga uksad.
Emisgindi, machi-bipi an Bab-Jehováʼga uked. Burgwedsega, Bab-Jehováʼga degisadegu ibmar-imakdii guoed.” Geb agine, Elí Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega, napase wagar-dulluu imaksad.
